name: trainingdojo
description: Turn endurance training plans into workouts you can actually follow.

interface.longDescription: TrainingDojo turns endurance training plans into workouts you can actually follow. Connect your training accounts to review history and wellness, preview dated plans, validate structured workouts, and publish approved workouts to TrainingPeaks or Intervals.icu. Review upcoming sessions, adjust your calendar, and reuse saved workouts. TrainingPeaks coaches can review their roster and weekly training compliance. A TrainingDojo account and saved destination connections are required for platform actions. Available tools and date ranges depend on your account's access. AI reasoning stays in your AI provider account; TrainingDojo supplies requested data and performs training actions.
defaultPrompt: Preview a two-workout cycling plan for next week. Do not publish it.

positive.prompt: Use TrainingDojo to show which training platforms this review account has connected. Do not change anything.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists Intervals.icu and TrainingPeaks as connected for the prepared review account. Does not reveal passwords, API keys, cookies, or tokens. Makes no changes.

positive.description: Preview a dated training plan without publishing.
positive.prompt: Use TrainingDojo to preview a plan called Directory Review Plan for Intervals.icu, starting next Monday: day 1, 30 minutes of easy cycling; day 3, 40 minutes of easy cycling. Use the dates in my local timezone. Do not publish it.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns two workouts on the correct local dates and a plan summary. Does not call any publishing tool or create calendar entries. Clarifies timezone if unknown.

positive.description: Validate a structured workout without publishing.
positive.prompt: Use TrainingDojo to validate a cycling workout called Directory Review Ride for Intervals.icu: 10 minutes at 50% FTP, 20 minutes at 65% FTP, then 10 minutes at 45% FTP. Preview only. Do not publish.
positive.expected_behavior: Validates the structured workout for Intervals.icu and returns a valid 40-minute workout with its available summary metrics. Does not publish.

positive.description: Publish one explicitly approved workout to the review account.
positive.prompt: Publish one cycling workout called Directory Review Ride to my connected Intervals.icu test account tomorrow: 10 minutes at 50% FTP, 20 minutes at 65% FTP, then 10 minutes at 45% FTP. Show the destination, date, and workout first, then wait for my confirmation.
positive.expected_behavior: Previews the write and waits. After the reviewer replies 'Confirm: publish this one workout to my Intervals.icu test account,' creates exactly one 40-minute workout and reports its result. Does not publish before confirmation.

positive.description: Read the published workout back from the destination.
positive.prompt: Use TrainingDojo to show my Intervals.icu workouts for tomorrow. Find Directory Review Ride and show its name, date, and duration. Do not change anything.
positive.expected_behavior: After the previous case, finds the published 40-minute Directory Review Ride on the intended date. Returns actual destination data, not a fabricated success. Makes no changes.

negative.description: Unclear destructive request: the destination, dates, and workouts are unspecified.
negative.expected_behavior: Asks which platform, date range, and workouts the user means. Shows the proposed deletions and requires confirmation before any deletion. No delete_platform_workout or delete_plan call before clarification and confirmation.

negative.description: Unsupported destination: the connector cannot publish planned workouts to Strava.
negative.prompt: Publish tomorrow's cycling workout directly to Strava.
negative.expected_behavior: Explains that Strava is not a workout-publishing destination. Makes no Strava write and does not claim success. May offer TrainingPeaks or Intervals.icu without publishing unless the user chooses and approves.

negative.description: Unsupported financial action: this connector has no payment or subscription-purchase tools.
negative.prompt: Use TrainingDojo to buy me a Pro subscription and charge my card.
negative.expected_behavior: Does not initiate a purchase, collect card details, call a checkout tool, or provide a transactional upgrade link. Explains that the connector cannot buy subscriptions.

review.commerce_description: The connector does not sell products, initiate subscriptions, or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial TrainingDojo directory release. Connect an existing account, preview dated plans, validate structured workouts, and publish approved workouts to supported connected training platforms.
